title: Multiscale Mechanisms of Fissured Expansive-Soil Failure
subtitle: Connecting cracks, material behavior and slope instability
question: How do cracks alter the mechanical behavior and failure mechanisms of expansive soils and slopes?
context: Fissured expansive soils and slopes investigated through laboratory, model-scale and field observations. The CV records this research during 2020–2024, with continuing research directions.
progress: Published work addresses fissure extension through fracture-mechanics tests and slope deformation under loading and irrigation. A study on sliding-surface microstructure is listed separately as a preprint in the CV.
direction: This research forms the Mechanics foundation of my current Scientific AI research. AI predictions should ultimately correspond to real material behavior, physical processes and failure mechanisms.
next: Connect physical-mechanism understanding with scientific learning of geosystem evolution and failure.
outputs: Published papers and a preprint are linked below, preserving the status recorded in the CV.
